title: Fine fans, their saturated ideal blowups and smooth functorial towers
statement:
Write commutative monoids additively. A fine monoid is finitely generated and embeds in its group completion; it is sharp if its only unit is $0$, and saturated if $ng\in P$, $g\in P^{\mathrm{gp}}$, $n>0$ implies $g\in P$ [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. The monoid spectrum $\operatorname{Spec}_{\mathrm{mon}}P$ has prime ideals $\mathfrak p$ (including the empty ideal), basic opens $D(a)=\{\mathfrak p:a\notin\mathfrak p\}$, and monoid sheaf with sections $P[a^{-1}]$ on $D(a)$; its sharp sheaf is the quotient by units. A fine fan $(F,\mathcal P_F)$ is a space with a sheaf of sharp monoids locally isomorphic to these sharpened spectra. Morphisms are continuous maps with local homomorphisms on stalks; local means that the inverse image of the units is the units. The fan is torsion free if every $\mathcal P_{F,z}^{\mathrm{gp}}$ is torsion free, saturated if its stalks are saturated, and smooth if each stalk is $\mathbf N^r$ for some finite $r\geq0$. A morphism of fans is smooth if at every point its stalk map $P\to Q$ identifies with the inclusion $P\to P\oplus\mathbf N^r$ for some finite $r$.

A nonempty coherent ideal $J\subset\mathcal P_F$ is a subsheaf stable under addition by $\mathcal P_F$, locally generated by a finite nonempty set. Its saturated blowup has, over an affine fan of a sharp fine monoid $P$ and ideal $I$, the charts given by the sharpened spectra of $(P[I-a])^{\mathrm{sat}}$, for a finite generating set $a\in I$; here $P[I-a]\subset P^{\mathrm{gp}}$ is generated by $P$ and all $b-a$ with $b\in I$, and saturation is taken in $P^{\mathrm{gp}}$. These charts are glued along their common monoid localizations. Pullback of an ideal means the ideal generated by its image. A finite saturated blowup tower retains its ordered centers. Pullback of a tower is defined recursively by blowing up the pulled-back centers. Contraction deletes precisely the stages whose center is the whole monoid sheaf. A smooth-functorial saturated desingularization of fine torsion-free fans assigns to every such fan with a finite affine cover a finite saturated blowup tower with smooth last fan, so that for every smooth morphism its assigned tower is the contracted pullback of the target tower, with the canonical identifications compatible with composition.
